catalog.registryApproved: This release was approved through the public Nimi App Registry. Its descriptor binds the exact Release asset, digest, and provenance, and Runtime verifies the downloaded package again. Approval and verification are not a malware-free or operating-system execution guarantee.
catalog.policyBlocked: New installation or launch is blocked by the current Registry policy (revision {{revision}}): {{reason}}
catalog.unsignedConfirmMessage: This exact Registry-approved release was not signed by its publisher with Authenticode. Its Registry descriptor binds the exact asset digest and provenance, and Runtime verifies the download again, but neither that nor Nimi review guarantees safety or creates a sandbox. Windows or your organization may warn or block it. Continuing asks Runtime to install this exact package; it does not grant the App administrator access, and any later launch is a separate current-user, non-elevated action.
catalog.macosUnsignedConfirmMessage: This app has no Developer ID publisher signature and has not been notarized by Apple. Nimi Registry review and download verification do not replace those checks, grant administrator access, or create an operating-system sandbox. Continue only if you trust this publisher.
catalog.macosUnnotarizedConfirmMessage: This app has a verified Developer ID signature, but no Apple notarization was observed. Continuing does not change that native verification status or grant administrator access.

catalogNotImplemented: Public App catalog search is not implemented yet.

downloads.title: Installations and downloads
downloads.emptyHint: Choose an App to install or update from the app list.
downloads.afterDownload: Package checks and installation follow. Completion will not automatically launch the App.
downloads.pausedHint: Progress is saved. Resuming adds this task to the end of the queue; other queued downloads can continue.
downloads.interruptedHint: Download interrupted. Available progress is saved. Resume to rejoin the queue.
downloads.committingHint: Finishing installation. This step cannot be paused or canceled; wait for the confirmed result.
downloads.failedHint: This task did not complete. Retry confirms the selected release again, or view the App to choose another available release.
downloads.verificationFailed: Package verification failed. This version was not installed. Invalid content was removed; a retry must pass all checks.
downloads.staleSelection: The selected release has changed. View the App and choose it again.
downloads.policyBlocked: Distribution of this release is blocked. View the App for currently available releases.
downloads.completedHint: {{version}} was installed. View the App for its current launch and run status.
downloads.canceledHint: Canceled. Temporary downloads were removed. The installed version and App data are retained.
downloads.updateUnavailable: This App cannot open while its update is active, queued, or paused. After cancellation is confirmed, you can use {{version}}. App data is retained.
downloads.updateCommitting: The update is being finalized, so this App cannot open yet. App data is retained.
downloads.disconnected: Latest status unavailable. Showing last confirmed progress. Speed, time remaining, and controls will return when the connection recovers.
downloads.controlFailed: Some actions were not confirmed. Tasks have been refreshed; continue from their current state.
downloads.ownerHint: Tasks continue while Runtime is running, even after Home closes. A completed task does not mean the App is running.
downloads.cancelMessage: Remove {{size}} downloaded for {{app}}. The installed App version, App data, shared models, and account data are retained.
downloads.totalUnknown: {{received}} downloaded · total size not available yet
downloads.navigationStale: Download status unavailable; last confirmed {{count}} unfinished
